vote_field: the per-cell draw of pca2_votes.py: np.random.RandomState(seed).choice(DRAW, p=DRAW_P) for pid in range(participants) for tid in range(comments)
basis: Generated fixture conversations. Since they were first recorded, seed-pca2.py wrote each draw into votes verbatim, i.e. as a stored value at agree = -1. This companion declares that sign; pca2_votes.py reads every draw through it and seed-pca2.py stores the meaning at the database's convention through delphi/tests/vote_fixtures.py, so the pca2 recordings no longer depend on the storage sign. No fixture byte is rewritten (P-078 1d).
